description: A comprehensive guide for running Large Language Models on your local hardware using popular frameworks like llama.cpp, Ollama, HuggingFace Transformers, vLLM, and LM Studio. Includes optimization techniques, performance comparisons, and step-by-step setup instructions for privacy-focused, cost-effective AI without cloud dependencies.
